scope.notes: Described as a one-off, server-side flush of BOTH consumption counters to zero, applied without user action and with no expiry — i.e. a counter reset, not a ceiling change. Reported as a courtesy 'release valve' two days after the May 13 temporary +50% weekly increase, so users could actually feel the new ceiling rather than remain capped by consumption already banked earlier that week. One source reports the announcement at 2:47 p.m. Italian time (approx. 12:47 UTC) on Friday May 15, but I set precision to 'day' rather than 'hour' because that timestamp comes from a single low-authority aggregator and I could not anchor it against any second source or vendor record.

evidence.author: Pasquale Pillitteri (news aggregator), quoting the @ClaudeDevs account
